969e0f4d-8320-4a06-8fb0-2502da819c8e.notes: AGGRO keyword == 'can attack even if not in play under your control since start of turn' (RULES.md §9). All shapes as classified.

39d69cc2-0af9-4e69-b31f-b7cc964353bb.notes: 'all other characters you control' modeled as forEach with `not cardNameEquals(__candidate, source)` (same idiom as Cantankerous Claywork); Rudo is UNIQUE so no false collisions. setRestoreLock pairs with the deplete per Intriguing Mezzanine. Strength scaler counts Rudo himself if he is ever depleted (text is not 'other').

506f383f-ef35-467b-8554-dd6b4b9729df.notes: 'choose a player and search their deck' modeled as a single deck-zone target with no owner filter (matches any player's deck) plus uniqueDesignation among the five designations; the picker effectively chooses the player by choosing the card. Reshuffle only fires when a card was found (owner of the searched deck is unknown otherwise).

6b29fb62-bd69-49ef-9f20-dc8712205d4f.notes: Aura scoped to type character (Eustace is a character designation).

fd095fbd-7566-4b39-832e-0f40a0181289.notes: 'When flipped down' payload folded into the destroy-replacement (the only path this card flips), per classification. Deviations: (1) replacement effect lists run through a non-suspendable loop in the engine, so the 'you may put a Micromajig token' is modeled as automatic rather than a chooser prompt; (2) 'each opponent's faction' / 'for each influence gained this way' collapse to a single opponent + single token in the 2-player engine; (3) an external effect flipping this card face-down will not fire the influence/token payload (classification-acknowledged edge).

f83b3af9-a7cb-4945-9632-bdfab77a111a.notes: AGGRO aura = 'all characters you control can attack even if not in play since start of turn'. RISK (classification-flagged): rememberTarget/linkedTargets are cleared when the source leaves play, which may race the same-event leaves-play trigger reading {remembered:'voidedJo'} — an engine 'remembered-target-survives-leave' fix (or targeting {owner:self, zone:void, uniqueDesignation:'jo'} instead) may be needed for the return clause to fire reliably.

f474ddf4-9fa8-44f2-b74c-9eebe554f125.notes: Four independent cumulative [V] paragraphs; at [V][V][V][V] all four apply for a net +2/+2/+2.

f75a2be6-4c8f-43e2-b23f-28d1892062c0.notes: [V] gate on a triggered ability via resourceIcons>=1 (face-down resources provide Volition, so this is nearly always live — matches the printed 'Volition-era' paragraph). Symmetric: fires for any character's battle damage to any faction, retaliating against that character's controller's faction.

e2b65004-fb6d-40f2-8f4c-18ee79e934fd.notes: PASS: X = discarded tactic's printed cost. The discard cost id 't' is supplied in the action's `selected` map, so the ability-level `variables.x` (evaluated after `selected` is merged, before targets/costs) can read cardCost({selected t}); the same selection feeds the discard cost. 'That character's controller may detach' uses ownerOf(v) captured against the still-valid instance (ownership is stable); detach selector is owner:opponent (relative to the Council's controller).

fc31573d-7f46-4e68-ab94-9ea36a3dbe90.notes: X = eventDamageAmount (damage inflicted to the faction). 'that opponent' = ownerOf(eventCard) where eventCard is the damaged faction instance.

0070ffff-bc96-4245-a7e8-d376941be247.notes: 'each opponent may detach up to 3 resources' — single opponent in the 2-player engine; count:3 + optional == 'up to 3'.

3c9d8aef-10a8-4834-af0f-fb3b3e4683c8.notes: 'restored character you control' == depleted:false. The sacrifice is a mandatory target declaration consumed by a `destroy` cost (targets are validated before costs are paid). [R][R][R][R][R][R] on JUST UNBEARABLE modeled as an ability icon threshold gate.

386bbf0c-3e4d-4db2-b476-70ce87b7e228.notes: DEVIATION: 'EXTRA COST: If you deployed this during an opponent's turn you may pay 1; if you don't, terminate it' is modeled as a mandatory conditional extra cost (pay 1 only when not the active player). `onPlay.effects` cannot safely host a `mayPay` pause (engine runs them in a non-suspendable loop), and declining is never advantageous, so this collapses to 'pay 1 or the card cannot be deployed' — outcome-equivalent except a would-be-terminated copy stays in hand instead of going to discard.

options.label: Put a resource you control into its owner's hand

25ba52f8-62c9-4e2c-8daa-7e6d841f6c76.notes: Fires on every character (incl. tokens) entering play under either player. 'a resource THEY control' can't be expressed via the selector's controller enum (it's self/opponent/any relative to the Council... err, the Machine's controller), so option 1 branches on eventCardControlledBy to pick the right controller filter. 'must choose one' == mandatory chooserSelectsOption. If option 1's chooser has no resources the nested declaration is a no-op (RULES.md §12).

63ad03b6-2fbb-46b0-9f86-f264cc1479fe.notes: EQUIP modeled as a re-attach (attachTo effect) since the card carries attachTo:'character'. EQUIP's X (0 vs 2) uses ability-level `variables` keyed off the action-supplied `ch` selection (settled before costs). 'when any other gear card is deployed' uses cardPlayed + cardSubtypeIs eventCard 'gear'.

f3c30c8a-69ce-443b-baed-afaed7170725.notes: 'Micromajig token or horsemajig character' matched by subtype ('micromajig' from the token spec, 'horsemajig' printed). PWNED's 'pick a ... character that this card is attached to' == the attachedTo host; the ability is gated to require the host be a micromajig/horsemajig (also enforces 'attached').

ef8e7666-c491-4bdd-96e8-880193a5b01b.notes: CLOCK OUT's 'COST: Flip this card face-down' modeled as the first effect (always possible, so not a distinct cost) per classification. 'Pick a face-down resource you control' uses faceDown:true with no type (any face-down card). 'Detach a resource' made an optional target to avoid a stuck mandatory pick when the controller has none.

1dd0bbbc-1202-41c2-9073-5ce87acaf67e.notes: 'that party' approximated as the current attacking party (classification). The battle-membership check is evaluated before the individual destroys, then the whole attacking party is destroyed, then the two picked characters are destroyed (a no-op if already gone as party members).

12b25597-1514-4fc3-9a33-3b32fc436ecb.notes: 'at least 2 face-down resources' == count of any face-down cards in play you control. deployFromZone waives only the numeric cost (threshold + extra costs still apply, matching the reminder text); gated to real character/item type since cardTypeIs sees the hidden definition type.

c6e93f75-e05d-4dfb-a77d-c74b662a7c02.notes: 'Reveal the top card of your deck' is a display-only step — not modeled as a card move; the revealed card is inspected in place via deckPosition top. The 0-4 branch excludes resources (a resource has numeric cost 0 and would otherwise match) so resources only hit the resource branch, per the classified shape. 'lose 1 life' == permanent life modifier.

3d8bb343-be8d-48d8-b3f2-523a3564ffeb.notes: Coin flip bound once via `bind` + `random` so the win/lose branches read the same result (a naive inline numberCompare(random) in each branch would re-roll). RISK: the leaves-play trigger reads `attachedTo`, which the engine may have already cleared as the source leaves play — same class of race noted on Testudine Autoframe.

43b9dddc-f557-4efa-86f9-6ce9ca46a277.notes: No attachTo metadata — the card only attaches via MOVE (classification). 'put it into play as a face-down resource ... instead' of destruction == optional destroy-replacement with optionalCost pay 2 + flipFaceDown. The printed text (per slice) has no 'attached character gains ...' clause, so MOVE's attachment carries no continuous effect; the `attachTo` effect just sets attachedTo (no state-based cleanup since the card has no attachTo definition).
